title: SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI: the rename that hasn't happened yet
subtitle: Three short posts, one promise, and three days of no visible change.
title_narration: SpaceX A.I. to SpaceX S.I. The rename that hasn't happened yet.
as_of: Grounded in Jim's Interest Journal research for Oct 4, 5 and 6, 2026.

scenes.label: Sunday, Oct 4
scenes.heading: Three posts from Elon Musk
scenes.caption: Early Sunday, Musk posted: No more AI. Then: SI. And: It's better.
evidence: Early Sunday Musk posted "No more AI," then "SI" and "It's better."

scenes.label: The promise

data.who: Elon Musk, asked if SpaceXAI would become SpaceXSI

scenes.caption: Asked whether SpaceXAI would be renamed SpaceXSI, he replied: Yes, we will make that change. He gave no timeline, and didn't say whether it's a legal or branding change.
evidence: Asked whether SpaceXAI would be renamed SpaceXSI, he replied "Yes, we will make that change." He gave no timeline and didn't say whether it's a legal or branding change.

scenes.label: Why now
scenes.heading: Following Washington's lead

lines: The move follows Trump's push for *"super intelligence"* over "AI."
Euronews: Trump announced a *"Super Intelligence Force"* on Sunday.

scenes.caption: The move follows Trump's push for super intelligence over AI. Euronews adds that Trump announced a Super Intelligence Force on Sunday.
evidence: The move follows Trump's push for "super intelligence" over "AI."
Euronews adds that Trump announced a "Super Intelligence Force" on Sunday.

scenes.label: Rename tracker
scenes.heading: Promised Sunday. Still not done.
scenes.caption: On Monday, Euronews said the company's websites and social accounts hadn't changed. By Tuesday, Tom's Hardware and TechRepublic said x.ai still uses AI and Artificial Intelligence throughout, with no formal announcement or timeline.
evidence: Euronews (6:42 a.m. ET) said the company's websites and social accounts hadn't changed.
On Tuesday, Tom's Hardware and TechRepublic said the x.ai site still uses "AI" and "Artificial Intelligence" throughout.
there's no formal announcement or timeline

scenes.label: Meanwhile at x.ai
scenes.heading: Quiet on the official channels
scenes.caption: Meanwhile, x.ai/news has no post newer than Sept 28, and the newest Grok Bot changelog entry is still v0.66.0 from Oct 2.
evidence: has no post newer than Sept 28
